text: Never before in your life have you seen a natural darkness like this one. It almost looks unnatural to you.
source_text: Never before in your life have you seen a natural darkness like this one. It almost looks unnatural to you.

text: You barely manage to keep your fears in check, but you are able to move into the darkness.
source_text: You barely manage to keep your fears in check, but you are able to move into the darkness.

text: 你以前从来没见过这种自然形成的黑暗，这对你来说太不正常了。
source_text: 你以前从来没见过这种自然形成的黑暗，这对你来说太不正常了。

text: 你勉强控制着你的恐惧，走进黑暗之中。
source_text: 你勉强控制着你的恐惧，走进黑暗之中。
